notes: SMALLER IMPROVEMENTS: Bills to check has a Find box, a Last 3 months view on Settled, and Not different after all to take back a choice. Up to four reports can be pinned to Quick open. Lodgement slips print page numbers. A sales or receipts file without a date column can be imported with one date for every row. An email can be offered from the unit above when a debtor has none (you check it before sending). A receipt matched to a bank statement keeps its number until the match is undone. Take a backup first: Setup, Backup, Back up now. No upgrade of the books: backups move freely between 1.7.0 and 1.8.2. Update the main computer first.
